name: toolbox-for-mac
title: Toolbox for Mac
description: Compress videos, remove backgrounds, merge PDFs, extract text, download videos and 30+ more file tools, right from Raycast. Requires the paid Toolbox for Mac app (2.0 or later); everything runs on your Mac.
author: nikhil_barik

commands.name: search-tools
commands.title: Search Toolbox Tools
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Find any Toolbox tool, pick files and options, and run it.

commands.name: compress-video
commands.title: Compress Video
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Makes the videos selected in Finder much smaller.

commands.name: compress-images
commands.title: Compress Images
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Makes the images selected in Finder smaller without visible loss.

commands.name: remove-background
commands.title: Remove Background
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Cuts out the subject of the photos selected in Finder as transparent PNGs.

commands.name: compress-pdf
commands.title: Compress PDF
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Makes the PDFs selected in Finder smaller.

commands.name: merge-pdfs
commands.title: Merge PDFs
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Combines the PDFs and images selected in Finder into one PDF.

commands.name: extract-text
commands.title: Extract Text from Files
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Reads the text in the images or PDFs selected in Finder and copies it.

commands.name: transcribe
commands.title: Transcribe Audio or Video
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Turns speech in the selected audio or video into text and copies it.

commands.name: video-to-gif
commands.title: Video to GIF
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Turns the videos selected in Finder into GIFs.

commands.name: download-video
commands.title: Download Video
commands.subtitle: Toolbox
commands.description: Saves a video or its audio from a link (YouTube, X, Vimeo and 1,000+ sites).

preferences.name: toolboxApp
preferences.title: Toolbox App
preferences.description: Pick Toolbox if it isn't in /Applications.

preferences.name: afterRun
preferences.title: When a Quick Command Finishes
preferences.description: What to do with the results of quick commands like Compress Video.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
